Cleaning raw data

Data cleaning involves identifying missing values, duplicates, inconsistent formats, impossible values, and other problems in raw information. The process should be based on an understanding of how the data were collected rather than simply changing unusual observations.

Every important cleaning decision should be documented. Original values should be preserved where possible so that changes can be checked and revised if new information becomes available.
